synthesis.content:
Central thread
Locate the demonstrations in relation to the Stonewall Inn and Christopher Park using the limited event record.

Evidence
Police raided the Stonewall Inn in the early hours of June 28, 1969. The raid prompted resistance and demonstrations continued on following nights in Christopher Park, across from the inn, and in the nearby neighborhood.
